projects.title: Revenue & Quality Scale-Up: Uriarte Talavera
projects.problem: A 200-year-old premium brand facing traditional production bottlenecks, lack of standardized quality control, and stagnant international sales.
action: Led end-to-end production for 70 staff across all ceramic lines.
Built the Quality Assurance department and 5S methodology from the ground up.
Deployed real-time operational dashboards for production control.
Developed a dedicated Quality Guide for Talavera authentication.
projects.result: Grew annual revenue by 30% and expanded the client portfolio by 20%, including luxury mandates for Rosewood Hotels and Zurich Insurance.

projects.title: Institutional IT Transformation: ISSSTE
projects.problem: Fragmented IT support across 38 healthcare facilities leading to critical delays in medical administrative workflows.
action: Standardized IT service processes and implemented a state-wide ticketing model.
Directed the rollout of the 'ISSSTEMED' Electronic Medical Record system.
Trained 120 employees as distributed IT supporters to decentralize technical expertise.
projects.result: Halved institutional IT response times and ensured operational continuity for the state healthcare network.

projects.title: Digital Capability Building at Scale: UPAEP
projects.problem: Bridging the gap between traditional educational methodologies and the required digital literacy for modern professional environments.
action: Designed and delivered curriculum for digital platforms and collaborative tools.
Developed structured capability-building frameworks applicable to corporate change.
Pivoted 100% of delivery to interactive digital methodologies.
projects.result: Established a departmental standard for digital tool adoption with consistently high engagement metrics.
